description: Comparison between FAVAD and general equations to evaluate the leakage lost flow in urban water distribution systems is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Raul Francischini Boian, Dhiogo Okumoto Macedo. ABSTRACT This paper models a real water distribution system (WDS) with a large number of leaks to determine if there is a difference between the flow lost by the WDS predicted by the FAVAD and the GENERAL equations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 310079 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
